title: Rhoads flying object photographs and enlargements, Figs. 1-4
description: Four photographs under the headings "ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPHS BY MR. RHOADS" (Figs. 1 and 2) and "ENLARGEMENTS OF ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPHS" (Figs. 3 and 4). The originals show a small dark object against the sky, with Fig. 1 bearing the marking "A-34921 A.C."; the enlargements show a dark, elongated, crescent-like silhouette. From a USAF Air Intelligence Report analysing flying disc sightings.
